Before a page enters search.

Inspect full sources. Resolve the local target, access and seasonal question. Check the gear system. Publish only the supported guide, then create its operator preparation link and a demonstration of the actual local decision. An imported brief stays noindex until those checks pass.

Exact-product review, affiliate tracking, operator inventory and hosted analytics remain separate integrations; none is invented by this release.
